newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-FONTANA TO RACE FOR SAUBER AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-FONTANA TO RACE FOR SAUBER AGAIN.

text.p: Argentina's Norberto Fontana will race for the Swiss-based Sauber team in this weekend's British Grand Prix at Silverstone, team sources said on Wednesday.
Fontana, 22, made his Formula One debut for Sauber at the French Grand Prix as stand-in for Italian Gianni Morbidelli, who had broken his arm in a testing accident.
Morbidelli is expected to return to action later this year.
